images.why: Stage 'flat rupee tiles marked Rs 1' in the Rupees tray (up to nine, three across): the owner's real Rs 1 coin photo, imported as supplied (no Gemini), drawn once per tile; the Rs 1 mark is also drawn in code
Look 'a price tag on a small shelf at the right' and Stage 'each an amber price tag': the two blank hanging tags, the amounts (Rs, dot, paise) drawn in code on top
images.prompt: A single plain blank cream kraft-paper hang tag with clipped top corners, a small reinforced round hole near the top with a short loop of natural jute string through it, a smooth empty paper surface.
